requirements.requirement: File Cash Transaction Report (CTR) for cash transactions equal to or exceeding VND 400,000,000 in aggregate per day

requirements.source: Luật Phòng chống rửa tiền 2022, Article 25
requirements.requirement: File Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) within 48 hours when transactions suggest money laundering, terrorist financing, or other financial crimes
Detect and report structuring — breaking transactions into amounts below VND 400M to avoid CTR threshold
Verify customer identity using CCCD (citizen identity card), passport, or business registration before account opening
Identify and verify beneficial owners holding 25% or more equity in corporate customers
Apply Enhanced Due Diligence for politically exposed persons (PEPs), high-risk customers, and customers from FATF grey/black list countries
Screen all customers and transactions against UN consolidated list, OFAC SDN list, and SBV domestic watch list
Maintain minimum Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) of 8% calculated as (Tier 1 + Tier 2 Capital) / Risk-Weighted Assets
Maintain minimum Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR) of 100% — high-quality liquid assets / 30-day net cash outflows
Limit single customer credit exposure to maximum 15% of bank's equity capital
Limit related party credit exposure to maximum 5% of bank's equity capital
Limit use of short-term capital sources for medium and long-term lending to maximum 30%
Classify loans into 5 groups based on days past due: Group 1 (≤10d), Group 2 (11-90d), Group 3 (91-180d), Group 4 (181-360d), Group 5 (>360d)
Apply specific provisioning rates: Group 1 (0%), Group 2 (5%), Group 3 (20%), Group 4 (50%), Group 5 (100%)
Conduct credit assessment including borrower capacity, purpose verification, and repayment source analysis before loan approval
Verify and document loan purpose and ensure disbursement matches stated purpose
Implement three lines of defense: operational management, risk/compliance, and internal audit
Verify customer identity for electronic banking using CCCD chip reading (NFC), biometric facial matching, and liveness detection
Enforce foreign ownership limits: individual investor 5%, institutional investor 15%, strategic investor 20%, total foreign ownership 30%
Submit daily liquidity reports, monthly balance sheets, quarterly CAR calculations, and annual audited financials to SBV within prescribed deadlines
Report all new credit facilities, modifications, payment status changes, and closures to CIC by 10th of following month
Protect customer personal data with encryption, access controls, and consent management; limit data sharing to authorized purposes
Maintain information security management system compliant with ISO 27001 standards and SBV requirements
Retain all customer identification records, transaction records, and STR documentation for minimum 5 years after account closure or transaction completion
Maintain corporate governance with independent board committees (Risk, Audit, Compensation) and separation between management and oversight functions
